newsitem.title: UK: Premier Farnell warns of profit shortfall.
newsitem.headline: Premier Farnell warns of profit shortfall.

text.p: British electronics components supplier Premier Farnell Plc said on Wednesday its pretax profit for the year ending February 2 would fall short of market forecasts by as much as 8.0 percent.

"During the second half of the year, the group has continued to experience weak market conditions, particularly in its volume distribution business," the company said, adding that sterling's strength also hit its profits.
Premier Farnell previously announced its plans to dispose of the distribution business.

"Group cash flow remains strong. The integration of Premier continues to proceed very well and the group's joint market development initiatives are being implemented with promising early results," the firm said.
Premier's shares sank 54.5p to close at 637.5.
